summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K to disclose the final summarized voting map from its Annual General Stockholders' Meeting held on April 28, 2026. The filing reports routine voting results on board elections and other ordinary agenda items, with no indication of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event. This is a standard post-meeting regulatory disclosure for a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16.
